heading: § 1-1. - How Code designated and cited.
text:
The ordinances embraced in this and the following chapters shall constitute and be
designated as the "Oklahoma City Municipal Code, 2020," and may be cited as such.

(Code 1970, § 1-1; Code 1980, § 1-1)

State Law reference—
Codification of municipal ordinances, 11 O.S. § 14-108.

heading: § 1-2. - Definitions and rules of construction.
text:
In the construction of this Code and of all ordinances, the following rules of construction
and definitions shall be observed, unless such construction or definition would be
inconsistent with the manifest intent of the Council, be repugnant to the context
of the provisions, or the context clearly requires otherwise:

(1)

Charter or City Charter. When the term "Charter" or "City Charter" is used in this Code, such term shall be
deemed to refer to the Charter of The City of Oklahoma City, as amended.

(2)

City. The words "the City" or "this City" shall be construed to mean The City of Oklahoma
City, Oklahoma.

(3)

City boundaries. The term "City boundaries" or "within the City" shall include not only the corporate
limits of the City, but also any property which it owns or which is under its jurisdiction.

(4)

Code. The term "Code" or "this Code" shall be deemed to refer to the Oklahoma City Municipal
Code, 2020, as established in Section 1-1 above.

(5)

Computation of time. The time within which an act is to be done, when expressed in days, shall be computed
by excluding the first day and excluding the last day if the last day be a Sunday
or a legal holiday designated by the Council, and if the time is expressed in hours
the whole of Sunday or of such legal holiday, from midnight to midnight, shall be
excluded.

State Law reference—
Legal holidays, 25 O.S. § 82.1 et seq.

(6)

Council. Whenever the words "Council" or "City Council" are used, they shall mean the Council
of The City of Oklahoma City.

(7)

County. The word "County" shall mean Oklahoma County, Cleveland County, Canadian County,
Logan County, Pottawatomie County or such other counties in which the City may be
located, or any combination thereof, as appropriate.

(8)

Delegation of authority. Whenever any authority, duty or other activity is charged to a City officer or employee,
it may be done as well by such person's duly appointed agent, so long as not prohibited
by ordinance, Charter or the laws or Constitution of the State, and so long as such
officer or employee retains supervision over the discharge of the duly delegated authority,
duty or activity.

(9)

Gender. Every word importing the masculine gender shall extend to and be applied to the feminine
gender and to the neuter gender unless the context clearly requires otherwise.

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 24.

(10)

Health Department. The words "Health Department" shall mean the City-County Health Department created
by agreement between the City and Oklahoma County pursuant to the provisions of 63
O.S. § 1-214, as amended.

Cross reference—
Health Department, § 23-16 et seq.

(11)

Joint authority. Words giving a joint authority to three or more public officers or other persons
shall be construed as giving such authority to a majority of them, unless clearly
expressed otherwise.

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 31.

(12)

May. The word "may" is permissive.

(13)

Municipal Court. The term "Municipal Court" shall have the meaning assigned to it in Section 33-1.

(14)

Nontechnical and technical words. Words and phrases shall be construed according to the common and approved usage of
the language; but technical words and phrases and such others as may have acquired
a peculiar and appropriate meaning in law shall be construed and understood according
to such meaning.

(15)

Oath. The word "oath" shall include an affirmation or declaration in all cases in which,
by law, an affirmation may be substituted for an oath, and in those cases the words
"swear" and "sworn" shall be the equivalent to the words "affirm" and "affirmed."

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 26.

(16)

Officers, departments, commissions, etc. Whenever any officer, department or board or commission is referred to by title only,
such reference shall be construed as if followed by the words "of The City of Oklahoma
City," unless the context clearly requires otherwise.

(17)

Oklahoma Statutes. All references to the Oklahoma Statutes in this Code shall be deemed to refer to
the latest edition of such statutes, as amended from time to time.

(18)

Or, and. The word "or" may be read "and." The word "and" may be read "or" if the sense requires
it.

(19)

Ordinance. The term "ordinance" shall mean an ordinance of The City of Oklahoma City, unless
the context clearly requires otherwise.

(20)

Owner. The word "owner," applied to a building or land, shall include a person with any
legal or beneficial interest in the property, including any part owner, joint owner,
tenant in common, tenant in partnership, joint tenant or tenant by the entirety, of
the whole or a part of the building or land.

(21)

Person. The word "person" shall extend and be applied to firms, corporations and any other
legal entity, voluntary associations, clubs, societies, trusts, or any other organization
as well as to individuals, unless plainly inapplicable.

(22)

Preceding, following. The words "preceding" and "following" shall mean next before and next after, respectively.

(23)

Property. The word "property" shall include real and personal property.

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 26.

(24)

Shall. The word "shall" is mandatory.

(25)

Sidewalk. The word "sidewalk" shall mean that portion of a street between the curbline and
the adjacent property intended for the use of pedestrians.

(26)

Singular and plural. Words in the plural include the singular, and vice versa.

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 25.

(27)

State. The words "the State" or "this State" shall be construed to mean the State of Oklahoma.

(28)

Street. The word "street" shall include any public ways, roads, highways, avenues, alleys
and lanes within the City.

(29)

Supervisor of Licenses. The term "Supervisor of Licenses" shall refer to that City officer or employee whose
function it is to issue licenses for the City.

(30)

Tenant, occupant. The words "tenant" and "occupant," when applied to a building or land, shall include
any person who occupies or is in possession of the whole or part of such building
or land, whether alone or with others.

(31)

Week. The word "week" shall be construed to mean seven days. Publication in a newspaper
of any notice or other matter indicated to be for a stated number of weeks shall be
construed to mean one insertion each week, unless specifically stated to be for each
day of the week or for more than one day in each week; all publications heretofore
made in accordance with the terms of this sentence are hereby validated.

(32)

Writing. The word "writing" shall include any representation of words, letters or figures,
whether by printing or otherwise.

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 28.

(33)

Year. The word "year" shall mean a calendar year.

State Law reference—
Similar rule of statutory construction, 25 O.S. § 23.

(Code 1970, §§ 1-2, 1-4; Code 1980, § 1-2; Ord. No. 18621, § 1, 11-4-86; Ord. No.
22540, § 1, 9-14-04)

heading: § 1-3. - References to Code; conflicts.
text:
(a)

All references to chapters, articles, divisions, or sections are to the chapters,
articles, divisions and sections of this Code unless otherwise provided.

(b)

If the provisions of different chapters or articles of this Code conflict with or
contravene each other, the provisions of each chapter or article shall prevail as
to all matters and questions growing out of the subject matter of that chapter or
article.

(Code 1980, § 1-3)
